mapper.insert: insert into mungmang_board (subject,username,contents,password, created_date, modify_date) values (#{subject},#{username},#{contents},password(#{password}), now(), null)
mapper.select: SELECT idx, subject, username, viewcount FROM mungmang_board ORDER BY idx desc
mapper.insert: update mungmang_board set viewcount = #{count} where idx = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(idx) as cnt FROM mungmang_board WHERE idx = #{idx} AND password = password(#{password})
